method.capture: RENDERED TEXT from a production build of the deployed code against a migration-only disposable database, all development bypasses off, every <details> opened, both entitlement states (Free and a comped Pro grant). Not read from source.
method.additional: the generated report's backend-authored claim block, which renders to PDF rather than to a page
method.note: The §317 inventory covered 9 public surfaces. Four of the five material findings are on surfaces it did not reach.

terminologyVerdicts.AI-powered: SUPPORTED_AS_WRITTEN if used — literally true, claims no ownership. NOT IN USE in rendered copy (source comment only)
terminologyVerdicts.AI-assisted: SUPPORTED_AS_WRITTEN if used — the most accurate available term. NOT IN USE
terminologyVerdicts.expert system: NOT IN USE. Would be MISLEADING — 'Expert' is an internal layer name and the formal evaluation failed
terminologyVerdicts.safety intelligence: SUPPORTED_WITH_QUALIFICATION — 14 uses, all in the footer tagline. Descriptive rather than a capability claim
terminologyVerdicts.reasoning engine: NOT IN USE. Would be SUPPORTED_WITH_QUALIFICATION for the deterministic engine only
terminologyVerdicts.autonomous / autonomously: MISLEADING_OR_OVERSTATED — 1 live use on /hazlenz; prohibited by the project's own guardrails
terminologyVerdicts.independent: NOT IN USE as a claim. The single occurrence is 'independently tracked findings', which is benign

contribution.provider: Semantic authoring in the Expert layer only. Ceiling-limited to 1 analysis/user/24h in production and may be disabled.
contribution.hazlenzOwned: Applicability rules, predicate model, unresolved-fact detection, citation selection, risk banding, corrective-action families, evidence boundary, admission/refusal/authority gates, governed knowledge base, provenance, lifecycle.
contribution.humanConfirmation: Predicate settlement, risk cell, corrective-action wording, finalization. Nothing auto-finalizes.
contribution.keyConsequence: The deterministic path is customer-authoritative and reaches a finding, citation, risk band and corrective action with NO provider involvement — proven at §317 on a corpus-free database. 'HazLenz AI' is attached 84 times to a product whose main path is not the AI.

capabilityBoundary.riskSeverity: BOUNDED — a governed scoring model, not a measured prediction
capabilityBoundary.traceability: BOUNDED — and over-claimed; no 'Reasoning Trace' surface exists

regulatoryVerdicts.correct standard: NOT IN USE. Would be MISLEADING

standardsCitationTrace.origin: A code-resident applicability rule in standard-applicability.rules.ts, selected by regex over the observation text. NOT a provider (none reachable, 0 calls) and NOT the database (every corpus table empty).
standardsCitationTrace.notANewFinding: KG-3F recorded the same property: 'citation SELECTION entirely in code with no database access'. §317's observation re-observes it.
standardsCitationTrace.existenceVerification: NOT PERFORMED AT REQUEST TIME. citation-structure.ts validates STRUCTURE only. Existence is a governance-time property.
standardsCitationTrace.applicabilityVerification: Lexical matching plus optional human predicate settlement. NOT a legal determination.
standardsCitationTrace.thisCitationInProduction: 29 CFR 1910.212(a)(1) — APPROVED_GOVERNED_CONTENT, exact match, authoritative text available, remediation NONE
standardsCitationTrace.uiAuthorityImplication: Hedging is strong and correct almost everywhere. Two strings are the exception: the heading 'Applicable standard (N)' and the state 'Applies'. Registered as CM-2.
standardsCitationTrace.transparencyInversion: The unseeded environment was MORE transparent than production: the 'has not completed source review' notice is suppressed for approved content.

accuracyClaims.detail: The single 'accuracy' occurrence is on /legal and is the USER's responsibility for the accuracy of what they enter — not a product claim.
accuracyClaims.futureValidationRequired: Stated per claim type in HAZLENZ-CAPABILITY-BOUNDARY.md. No percentage was manufactured and no development result was extrapolated.

safetyOutcomeClaims.note: A clean result. The prohibition is recorded preventively in CLAIM-VOCABULARY.md.

securityPrivacyVerdicts.secure: SUPPORTED_WITH_QUALIFICATION — 2 uses, both about Stripe-hosted checkout and the reset flow, not about the product's own security
securityPrivacyVerdicts.encrypted: MISLEADING_OR_OVERSTATED as presented (CM-3). AES-GCM is real; the key sits in cleartext beside the ciphertext and the PIN does not gate decryption
securityPrivacyVerdicts.deleted: SUPPORTED_WITH_QUALIFICATION — must state that backups and recovery generations retain data for their window
securityPrivacyVerdicts.permanently deleted: NOT IN USE. Would require the backup qualification
securityPrivacyVerdicts.backed up: SUPPORTED_WITH_QUALIFICATION — subject to the laptop-scheduler limitation
securityPrivacyVerdicts.monitored: SUPPORTED_WITH_QUALIFICATION — an alerting channel on a 5-in-5 aggregation, not uptime monitoring
securityPrivacyVerdicts.tamper-proof: NOT IN USE. PROHIBITED — integrity verification is detective, not preventive

offline.actualBoundary: IN: field capture, drafts, photo evidence, device-local storage. OUT: HazLenz analysis, reports, corrective actions, sync-on-demand only.
